svg.aria-label: STAR breakdown of the deliberate climb into Staff / GenAI story
svg.text: Story 10 · The deliberate climb into Staff / GenAI — STAR
11+ yrs; most of a decade in long-tenured roles built deep, stable
ownership — but system scope and AI were moving faster than one seat.
Own my growth on purpose: climb into Staff scope + pivot into GenAI.
Sequenced the climb: Egnyte -> ServiceNow -> Atlassian, each a step up
in system complexity + ownership. At ServiceNow, pivoted commerce -> GenAI,
self-teaching LLM / agentic systems (LangChain, LangGraph, RAG) + a standing
AI-system-design study habit; turned each new skill into shipped scope.
A decade of depth parlayed into a fast, deliberate climb + a clean pivot into GenAI.
Lesson: treat your own growth as an owned project — pick the harder system on purpose.
Signals: continuous learning · growth mindset · deliberate career ownership · AI-landscape comfort
The per-move reasons and GenAI ramp timeline are placeholders — fill in the real specifics before using.
